query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.is_vip, a.free_preview_count, 
       COUNT(p.id) as total_photos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_free_preview = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as free_preview_photos
FROM albums a
LEFT JOIN photos p ON p.album_id = a.id
WHERE a.is_vip = 1
GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.is_vip, a.free_preview_count
LIMIT 10;
